input_contract.subject: A governed Revit document and the set of object classes selected for naming validation.
required_governance_inputs: controlled vocabulary for each tested naming surface
preconditions: The document is readable through an approved Revit API execution context.
Each tested object class can be mapped to an available governed naming surface.

steps: Enumerate applicable governed Revit objects and record object class, stable identifier, and current name.
Resolve the governed syntax/vocabulary for each object class.
Parse each name against token order, delimiter, vocabulary, and identity rules.
Record violations, ambiguities, duplicates, and objects whose governing vocabulary is unavailable.
Map findings to ATS result states without deriving new naming authority.
execution_contract.safety_boundary: Read-only. The checker shall not rename Revit objects or modify naming registries.
execution_contract.authority_boundary: The ETS tests conformance to governed S4/L6 rules; it cannot approve new names, tokens, or vocabularies.

required_observations: finding records with object id, object class, name, and failed rule where available

result_mapping.pass: All applicable tested objects conform to complete governed naming rules and no unresolved governance input remains.
result_mapping.fail: At least one tested object positively violates an available governed naming rule.
result_mapping.not_applicable: No object in scope is governed by a naming rule.
result_mapping.indeterminate: One or more applicable object classes cannot be evaluated because the governing syntax or vocabulary is incomplete or unavailable.

provenance.migration_note: Appendix E Revit/ZEN ETS contract. Not implemented until a callable and governed vocabulary inputs are available.
